review_notes: I read the whole file and the related definitions. `schemeHomOverComp_coe` is already `@[simp]` in Def_AlgebraicGeometry_RelativeGroupLaw.lean. `push_val` is `@[scoped simp]` and is used via `simp only`, which looks fine. The `*_val_congr` lemmas and `map_*` lemmas take hypotheses, so they are poor simp candidates and I did not flag them. The one clear gap is the `Spec.map` analogue of Mathlib's `PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal`. I did not run Lean, so I make no claim about how the simplifier behaves on this lemma. The finding is modest, and `specMap_base_asIdeal` is called with an explicit `rw` four times.

findings.excerpt: theorem specMap_base_asIdeal {R R' : Type} [CommRing R] [CommRing R'] (φ : R →+* R') (p : PrimeSpectrum R') :
findings.problem: The lemma is the scheme-level counterpart of Mathlib's simp lemma `PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal`. It has no `@[simp]` attribute, so `simp` cannot rewrite `((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).base p).asIdeal` to `Ideal.comap φ p.asIdeal`. Every use therefore goes through an explicit `rw [specMap_base_asIdeal]`. The call sites are lines 257 (applied twice in one `rw`), 285, 344 and 353. In `exists_common_geomPoint`, lines 257 and 285 are each followed by `simp only [hbotk]` and a manual `← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot`, so the normal form is built by hand each time.
findings.proposed_change: Mark the lemma `@[simp]`. Its right-hand side `Ideal.comap φ p.asIdeal` is simpler and the rewrite cannot loop. Alternatively, state it with `Spec.map f` for a general `f : R' ⟶ R`, matching how it is used, and tag that version `@[simp]`. The `rw ... at` calls can then become `simp only [specMap_base_asIdeal]` or plain `simp`, which also lets them combine with `hbotk` and `Ideal.comap_comap`.
findings.benefit: Users and proofs get a canonical normal form for the ideal of the image of a prime under `Spec.map`. This removes the repeated manual `rw` steps and the occurrence-counting such as `rw [specMap_base_asIdeal, specMap_base_asIdeal]`, and it matches the existing Mathlib simp convention for `PrimeSpectrum.comap`.
